contract_snapshot.interface:
final class Drupal\csobrec\Service\DayRun. Constructor (DaktelaClient $daktela, CallMapper $mapper, Selection $selection, Naming $naming, Mp3Converter $converter, SentLedger $ledger, BatchBuilder $builder, \Drupal\Core\Config\ConfigFactoryInterface $configFactory, \Drupal\Core\Logger\LoggerChannelFactoryInterface $loggerFactory). This is the whole morning in one method; everything it talks to is already written and tested, so do not re-implement a rule here — ask the service that owns it.

build(\DateTimeImmutable $day, \DateTimeImmutable $batchTime, string $directoryUri, string $workDir): array
$directoryUri is where the batch is assembled (a private:// stream URI, customer data); $workDir is a plain existing filesystem directory for the downloads and the conversion, because ffmpeg cannot write into a stream wrapper. A $workDir that is not an existing writable directory is \RuntimeException naming it.

STEP 1, the queues. Read csobrec.settings:fronty, a map 'queue number' => mode label. Careful: PHP turns a numeric string array key into an int, so those keys come back as ints (5003, not '5003'). Cast every key to a string before you compare it with Call::$queue, which is a string — '5003' === 5003 is FALSE under strict types and the whole Logic branch would silently do nothing. Turn every label into a QueueMode with QueueMode::fromLabel(); NULL means an unknown label and that is \InvalidArgumentException naming the queue and the label, thrown BEFORE any request is sent — a typo in the mode must not quietly mean 'send everything' or 'send nothing'. An empty map means no request at all and a result full of zeroes.

STEP 2, the day. $daktela->callsOfDay($day, <queue numbers>) — it asks once per queue. Map every activity with $mapper->fromActivity(); an \InvalidArgumentException from there counts into 'unmappable' and that activity is dropped (a live instance holds rows nobody can read, and one of them must not cost us the morning). Keep the readable Call objects by activity id, so the same id never appears twice.

STEP 3, the history. For every queue whose mode is QueueMode::Logic, take the calls of that queue whose disposition is '[CSOB] Nový prodej' or '[CSOB] Nový prodej TZ', collect their distinct phone numbers and ask $daktela->callsOfNumber($phone, $queue) ONCE per number (if you keep them distinct as array keys, cast each key back to a string — callsOfNumber takes a string and strict types would throw a TypeError on the int) — 'historyQueries' is how many such questions were asked. Map the answers the same way and add only the activity ids that are not known yet; 'historyCalls' is how many calls the history ADDED. An \InvalidArgumentException from callsOfNumber (a number too short to be asked about safely) is skipped the same way as an unmappable row, with a warning in the log.

STEP 4, the selection. $selection->select(<all known calls>, <the mode map>) returns Items. 'selected' is how many of them are copy 1 (that is: how many calls were selected), 'xsellCopies' how many are copy 2. 'calls' is the number of readable calls known for the day, history included.

STEP 5, what ČSOB already has. Ask $ledger->alreadySent() ONCE for the distinct activity ids of the selected items and drop every item of those calls, the X-sell copy included. 'alreadySent' is how many CALLS were dropped this way. This happens before anything is downloaded: their importer refuses a recording it already has, and we must not fetch customer audio we are not going to send.

STEP 6, the recordings. For each remaining call, once per call and not once per item: $daktela->recording($activity). NULL counts into 'withoutRecording' and the call drops out (a line in the index with no file behind it is a batch ČSOB rejects). Otherwise download to $workDir . '/' . $activity . '.' . <extension> where the extension is the extension of the answer's 'recording' value, or its 'format' when that has none, or 'ogg'; then $converter->convert(<that file>, $workDir . '/' . $activity . '.mp3'). A \RuntimeException from either counts into 'failed' and the call drops out — one broken recording must not cost us the whole morning — and the reason goes into the 'csobrec' log channel.

STEP 7, the batch. For every item of a call whose mp3 is ready, the file name is $naming->mp3($call->time, $call->activity) for copy 1 and $naming->mp3($call->time, $call->activity . '_2') for copy 2, and the index line is $mapper->lineFromItem($item, <that name>). Both copies point at the SAME converted mp3: it is one recording handed over twice under two proposal numbers. 'inBatch' is the number of items (files) that made it. With nothing to send call the builder at all: 'batch' is NULL, 'activities' is [] and not a single file or folder is created — ČSOB must not receive an empty batch. Otherwise 'batch' is what $builder->build($directoryUri, $batchTime, $items) returned.

RETURNS an array with exactly these keys: 'calls', 'unmappable', 'selected', 'xsellCopies', 'withoutRecording', 'failed', 'alreadySent', 'inBatch', 'historyQueries', 'historyCalls' — all int — plus 'activities' (a list of ['hovor' => <activity id>, 'fronta' => <queue>], one row per CALL in the batch, so an X-sell copy is not a second call) and 'batch'. Every other value in the result must be an int: the result is printed on the operator's terminal and written into the log, and a phone number, a name or a proposal number must never get there. The working files are left behind for the caller to clean up or to diagnose from.
contract_snapshot.notes: Pokus 1 (2026-10-27) spálil budget u obou rodin modelů na témže místě: klíče 'fronty' se porovnávaly s Call::$queue bez přetypování, takže Logic fronta se vůbec nezpracovala a 'calls' vyšlo 5 místo 7. Triage i druhý názor to hlásily jako nesplnitelnou akceptaci; ruční průchod řetězcem (11 tvrzení) ukázal, že splnitelná je. V akceptaci se opravila jen fixtura nečitelného řádku a4 (chyběl mu 'time', takže ho denní filtr Daktely zahodil).
